source.title: WDC Monthly Digest - November 2019
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of November 2019.

During November, three new official investigations were opened and three ongoing investigations were closed, making it a relatively quiet month.

Since no important update is available, the WDC decided to use this Monthly Digest to share an internal document that outlines the Modus Operandi of the Committee. We hope that it will give an inside view about the process we follow for official investigations.

The document is available at this link.

To conclude this short Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

translation.title: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 11 月
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 11 月的重要动态。

11 月新开三项正式调查，结束三项在办调查，相对平静。

没有重大更新，因此本期分享一份介绍委员会工作方式的内部文件，希望让大家了解正式调查流程。文件见[此链接](https://drive.google.com/a/worldcubeassociation.org/file/d/1g5PhbrbW2OtLgQSFdpkyqjVR4QSZlc0P/view?usp=sharing)。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
